result.summary: The screen displays a generally clean UI for a food delivery app, but contains one major layout issue related to cut-off content.

issues.description: The bottom card showing a pizza is partially cropped at the bottom of the screen, indicating poor vertical spacing or viewport handling.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the padding or scroll margins at the bottom of the content container to ensure the full height of the bottom-most list items is visible.

issues.description: The category pill buttons (All, Pizza, Sushi, etc.) have a layout that makes the 'Healthy' pill appear partially cut off at the edge of the scrollable container.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding to the scrollable row container to ensure the last pill is fully visible and not flush against the screen edge.
